description: IEEE RTS 79, IEEE 118 and a real world provincial power system is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yan Yang, Wenyan Shu. "In the IEEE RTS-79 and IEEE 118 systems, source domain load variations follow a normal distribution with a mean equal to the initial load and a standard deviation of 10%. The target domain introduces a 10% penetration of wind and photovoltaic power based on the source domain settings. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
